step.cmd: Log in to the SMS web application.

result.p: You can customize the list view by applying filters. The following table explains the available filters and the motor details displayed on the List view.
result.note: Note: The list of motors displayed changes based on the selection on the left navigation pane. If a particular location or plant is selected, the list displays all the motors of only that location or plant.

row.entry: The search box used to locate specific motors. To search for a motor from the list, type in any keyword related to the motor including its name, process, plant, description, status, or action. placeholder Figure 12 Search box on List View

The name of the motor. To filter or customize the motors list based on motor name, click the placeholder arrow and select one or more motor names from the drop-down list. placeholder Figure 13 Motor Filter on List View

The plant and process name associated with the motor. To filter or customize the motors list based on their corresponding plant and process, click the placeholder arrow and select one or more combinations of plant and process name. placeholder Figure 14 Plant / Process Filter on List View

The current health status of the motor. To filter or customize the motors list based on their health status, click the placeholder arrow and select one or more health statuses from the drop-down list. placeholder Figure 15 Status Filter on List View
The description of the current health status. For example, if a motor’s status is Alarm, this field describes the fault detected with the motor.
The suggested course of action to be taken to fix a fault.
